```plato
    // The two bodies after a spring has acted for one step: the spring force turned
    // into an impulse by multiplying by the step, and applied at the two anchors.
    // Coincident anchors have no line of action and the spring does nothing.
    ApplySpring(bodies: Array<SolverBody3D>, joint: SpringJoint, seconds: Number): Array<SolverBody3D>
    {
        var a = bodies[joint.BodyA.Value];
        var b = bodies[joint.BodyB.Value];
        var anchorA = WorldAnchor(a, joint.AnchorA);
        var anchorB = WorldAnchor(b, joint.AnchorB);
        var span = anchorA.Between(anchorB);
        var separation = span.Magnitude;
        var axis = separation > 0.0 ? span / separation : Vector3D(0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
        var impulse = separation <= 0.0
            ? 0.0
            : SpringForce(joint, separation - joint.RestLength.Amount,
                SeparationSpeed(a, b, anchorA, anchorB, axis)) * seconds;
        return ReplacedAt(
            ReplacedAt(bodies, joint.BodyA.Value, ApplyImpulse(a, axis * -impulse, anchorA)),
            joint.BodyB.Value,
            ApplyImpulse(b, axis * impulse, anchorB));
    }
```
